findings.verdict_rationale: The core LowCode Example Generator pipeline is end-to-end functional for Cells (9/9 scenarios published, 4 PRs merged), Words (4/4 scenarios published, 4 PRs merged), and PDF (PR #1 merged, PR #3 validated and awaiting APPROVE_LIVE_PR). Agent Metrics are implemented with production posting verified once (pilot-cells run, http_status=200). Tests pass at 1025 (full suite, 24.64s, 0 failures). However, 3 CRITICAL structural gaps prevent the verdict from being FULLY_IMPLEMENTED_AND_PRODUCTION_READY: (1) no coverage denominator model artifact (coverage claims are unverifiable), (2) no run-to-run comparison mechanism (non-degradation is real but not automated), (3) no scenario contracts (rerun consistency is structurally weak). Evidence integrity score is 77/100. Governance workstream is only 15% implemented-verified.
why_not_fully_implemented_and_production: CRITICAL GAP 1 (C1): No coverage denominator model artifact exists anywhere in the repository. Coverage claims ('15/43 = 35%') cannot be verified against any artifact. This is a structural gap, not a documentation gap — there is no machine that computes the denominator.

CRITICAL GAP 2 (G6): Run-to-run comparison mechanism does not exist (CA-21 VERIFIED_FALSE). Non-degradation of Cells 9/9 and Words 4/4 is real but proven only manually by reading two evidence files, not by any automated check. A new LLM run could silently regress a passing scenario without detection.

CRITICAL GAP 3 (C7): No machine-readable completion queue exists. Backlog exists only for PDF family (workspace/backlog/pdf/). Cells has 13 excluded scenarios, Words has 21 excluded scenarios — none have machine-readable backlog entries.

CRITICAL GAP 4 (C12, pipeline/contracts/): No static scenario contracts exist. Scenario plans are inferred at runtime from api-catalog.json, meaning a different api-catalog.json could produce a different scenario plan silently.

EVIDENCE GAP: Evidence integrity score is 77/100 (23 deductions). Latest/ root is overwrite-vulnerable (_last_promoted_by.json = pdf). 5 ZIP bundles without manifests. 4 MEMORY.md contradictions with higher-authority sources.
GOVERNANCE GAP (G workstream at 15%): Monthly rerun is manual, CI workflow absent, taskcard markdown sync is manual (currently in sync but fragile).
findings.why_not_partially_implemented_with_struc: The pipeline IS fully functional for all 3 families end-to-end. Cells 9/9 and Words 4/4 are published. PDF PR #1 is merged. PDF PR #3 is validated (not blocked by technical issues, only by APPROVE_LIVE_PR human token). Agent metrics production posting is verified. 1025 tests pass. The gaps are in observability, governance, and coverage computation — not in the core generation, validation, and publication pipeline. The pipeline can process a new scenario if added to allowed_types — it is not structurally broken.

structural_weaknesses: SW-01: Scenario plans inferred at runtime — no static contracts; a changed api-catalog.json silently produces different scenarios

SW-04: release_status.py last_pr_number is structurally stale — design limitation; shows only most recent run's PR, not cumulative count
SW-05: Non-degradation proof is manual — no --compare-run flag, no regression_detected field, no CI gate; Cells 9/9 could silently regress
findings.production_readiness: PRODUCTION_CAPABLE_WITH_OPERATIONAL_GAPS — The core pipeline is production-capable: it generates, validates, and publishes C# examples to real GitHub repos via real API calls. All 3 families have published examples in production repos. However, for sustained production operation, the following are gaps: (1) no automated regression detection means human must manually compare evidence files after each run; (2) no coverage denominator means progress cannot be reported authoritatively; (3) evidence integrity at 77/100 means stale artifacts exist that could mislead operators
